display.title: From Purim to Pesach: One Geulah to the Next
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi links the miracles of Purim and Pesach and teaches that the final Geulah, in the month of Nissan, can come as fast as the blink of an eye.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, broadcast between Purim and Pesach. Our Sages teach that it is good to connect one redemption with another, and Uncle Yossi links the Geulah of Purim with the Geulah of Pesach. In both, Hashem saved the Jewish people with great miracles: at the splitting of the Yam Suf the nations trembled, as we say every day in Az Yashir, and in the days of Purim many people joined the Jews out of awe. So too Hashem will free us from this final galus with miracles even greater than the Exodus, as the Navi foretells. In Nissan we were redeemed and in Nissan we will be redeemed again, and as the Rebbe teaches, this complete redemption will never be followed by another galus. Looking ahead to Shabbos Mevarchim Nissan, the month of redemption, Uncle Yossi explains that Hashem's salvation can come as quickly as the blink of an eye. This cut ends there, before the closing call to be in shul.
display.lesson: Hashem's redemption can come in the blink of an eye; hope and pray for it.

date.note: Cut from episode 370, dated 28 March 1989 in its filename; mentions Purim just past and Shabbos Mevarchim Nissan this week.
